node.statement: Row-column compressed-product estimate: there are universal C_rc < infinity and e_rc > 0 such that, whenever e = delta+epsilon <= e_rc, P,Q are delta-projections in an extended epsilon-C*-algebra A, n >= 1, and X,Y are in M_{n,1} tensor S_{P,Q}, one has ||Co_Q(Y^dagger X) - Y^dagger X|| <= C_rc*e*||Y||*||X||, where Y^dagger X is the ambient product of the 1-by-n row Y^dagger with the n-by-1 column X.
